metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for CreateFuture delivery and engineering teams

plugins.name: delivery-tooling
plugins.description: Create a new client project folder from the delivery KB template, with an optional GitHub repo. Needs Claude Code and xSolutions365 GitHub access.

plugins.name: governance-tools
plugins.description: Start here. Review a Statement of Work for supplier risk, score an engagement's delivery risks, or check a project knowledge base against CreateFuture's ISO delivery requirements.

plugins.name: agent-setup
plugins.description: Tell Claude about your role, your project and how you like to work. It asks a few questions and saves the answers to your project's CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: okf-commands
plugins.description: For developers. Commands for a personal notes vault in Open Knowledge Format: add notes, summarise folders, check links and ask questions with citations.

plugins.name: engagement-reporting
plugins.description: Turn your notes into the weekly or fortnightly client check-in report and a branded presentation. No notes? It can interview you instead.

plugins.name: kb-creation
plugins.description: Set up and run an engagement knowledge base, step by step: create it, configure it for the client, onboard the team, capture meeting notes and documents, and archive it at the end. Setup needs Claude Code.

plugins.name: example-skills
plugins.description: A practice skill that tells a joke. Use it to check that your install works.
